## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs:`)
- [ ] Refactor or performance improvement (`refactor:`, `perf:`)
- [ ] Tooling or CI update (`ci:`, `chore:`, `build:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's formatting and style conventions (`cargo fmt`, `clang-format`, `eslint`).
- [ ] I have run all linters without warnings (`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`).
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass.
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) in English.
- [ ] Every commit includes the mandatory trailer:
  `Co-authored-by: toiyeuyuriiiii <toiyeuyuriiiii+github@gmail.com>`
- [ ] Every commit is cryptographically signed (GPG or SSH).
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, or `.env` files are committed.
